interface.longDescription: AccountsOS is an AI accountant for founders, sole traders and small companies. Ask Finn about your books in plain English: cash, spending, who owes you, bills due, profit and loss, VAT, payroll, your director's loan, and tax and Companies House deadlines. New to AccountsOS? Finn sets up your business in the chat and reads in the bank statements, receipts and invoices you attach. Accountancy practices can ask across their whole client book. Finn never files a return or makes a payment from ChatGPT.
